50 Best Action Movies From The 1990’s

This was a decade that gave us some of the most iconic action films of all time, and I've compiled a list of the top 50 that you won't want to miss.

Originally published 26 March 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Lists & RecommendationsAction

What We Cover In This Article

  • This article compiles a list of the 50 best action movies from the 1990s, featuring legendary actors and talented filmmakers.
  • The list includes a diverse range of films, from high-octane thrillers to martial arts classics to sci-fi blockbusters.
  • Some of the most featured actors on the list include Bruce Willis, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone, Jean-Claude Van Damme, Keanu Reeves, and Harrison Ford.
  • Some of the most featured directors on the list include John Woo, James Cameron, Luc Besson, Michael Bay, Tony Scott, Renny Harlin, and Jan de Bont.
  • The list is organised into years to give it a timeline feel.

Summary

Top Featured Directors:

  • James Cameron - Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991), True Lies (1994)
  • John McTiernan - Die Hard 2 (1990), The Hunt for Red October (1990), Die Hard with a Vengeance (1995)
  • Jan de Bont - Speed (1994), Twister (1996)
  • John Woo - Hard Boiled (1992), Face/Off (1997)
  • Renny Harlin - Cliffhanger (1993), The Long Kiss Goodnight (1996)

Top Featured Actors:

  • Bruce Willis - Die Hard 2 (1990), The Last Boy Scout (1991), Die Hard with a Vengeance (1995), The Fifth Element (1997)
  • Arnold Schwarzenegger - Total Recall (1990), Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991), True Lies (1994)
  • Sylvester Stallone - Cliffhanger (1993), Demolition Man (1993)
  • Keanu Reeves - Point Break (1991), Speed (1994), The Matrix (1999)

Year with most films on the list: 1994 (with 8 films)

Highest Box Office Films on the List:

  • Men in Black (1997) - $589,390,539
  • Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) - $519,843,345
  • The Matrix (1999) - $463,517,383
  • True Lies (1994) - $378,882,411
  • Speed (1994) - $350,448,145

(Note: Box office figures are worldwide gross earnings, not adjusted for inflation.)

The 1990s were a fantastic decade for action movies, and this list of the top 50 films is a testament to that. From classic sequels to groundbreaking originals, these films feature some of the most impressive action sequences and standout performances in cinematic history. Whether you're a die-hard action fan or just looking for a fun and entertaining movie to watch, these films are sure to deliver. So, grab some popcorn, sit back, and enjoy the ride!
